description: HTML with Qualor's default HTMLHint rules: a full page with real mistakes, and an Angular fragment that only trips frame-title-require

notes.index.html#ncloc: 18 lines - 1 comment line (7) - 1 blank line inside <script> (14) = 16 (report-format.md §6: text and script bodies count their non-blank lines only)
notes.index.html#tag-no-obsolete: HTMLHint reports <center> at its start and its end tag, both on line 11 with the same text; the pass keeps one
notes.partials/card.html: an Angular template: no doctype, no <head>, [class.active] and (click) attributes and {{ }} text stay silent under Qualor's set; only the iframe without an accessible name is reported
notes.severity: report-format.md §7.1: attr-no-duplication is a correctness rule (reliability/medium), alt-require, html-lang-require and frame-title-require accessibility rules (maintainability/medium), title-require and tag-no-obsolete others (maintainability/low), whatever HTMLHint's error/warning
